subject: Personally I have not
author: Xandu
body:
Personally I have not completed Burnout Dominator 100%, but I have contacted one of our members that have completed the game 100% and he will have a look at your question.

subject: As far as I can remember
author: Jasman
body: As far as I can remember (this was a long time ago), there wasn't anything special you needed to do to complete the game 100%, but you needed gold in every event, and needed all the trophies (or what they were called) unlocked.

subject: What Console are you on?
author: jamm13dodger
body: What Console are you on? If it;s Xbox get yourself on 360achievements.org or similar and make sure you've done them all.

subject: my problem
author: fastcubesolver
body: wait, i have an update, i have 9,950 points, but I have still unlocked everything, all the cars, shortcuts, etc, and i have all the gold medals. Also, I have all of the trophies won. A silver medal is worth 50 points, how does that make any sense? Could this be a glitch?

subject: Playstation 2 or PSP only
author: ZombieTron
body:
Burnout Dominator was a PS only game, I don't think it will make a difference if you play on PSP or PS2. I have no idea why you are still missing a %. We have Dominator on PSP, but I really don't like handheld gaming so have massively underplayed it... doesn't help that it has about a dozen versions of Avril Lavignes Girlfriend on the soundtrack either!

It could be a glitch I guess, as long as you know you have done everything you can, I guess you should try not to worry about it too much!
